contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeNewSale(): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentCashDesk: CashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk,
		currentSale: Sale = self.CurrentSale
	precondition:
		currentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and
		if currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then true 
		else currentSale.IsComplete = true 
		endif 
	postcondition:
		let newSale: Sale in
		newSale.oclIsNew() and
		Sale.allInstances()->includes(newSale) and
		newSale.IsComplete = false and
		newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and
		newSale.BelongedCashDesk = currentCashDesk and
		currentCashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(newSale) and
		self.CurrentSale = newSale and
		result = true
}
